prompts.task: Instrument the FastAPI and Celery service in ./service with OpenTelemetry while preserving the existing Docker Compose runtime. Add auto-instrumentation only. The API startup must use a separate explicit OTel setup module and instrument its Celery producer before publishing tasks so the POST /orders context propagates to the worker. In worker.py, import the side-effect-free setup callable and CeleryInstrumentor at module load; do not lazy-import either inside worker_process_init. Provider-free import means those imports have no setup side effect: only invoke setup and Celery instrumentation inside worker_process_init. Makefile-, Dockerfile-, Compose-, entrypoint-, or CLI-wrapper-only instrumentation is insufficient.

checks.description: Docker runtime emits FastAPI traces to a running Splunk Observability Studio.
